summary:
Iteration 6 — Experience Output upgrade (feature flag `experience_output`). Frontend-only, 390x844 against the public preview. ALL eight scenarios A–H PASS. Final GET /api/config/public confirms experience_profiles=true, experience_builder=true, experience_output=true. No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages detected, zero page errors captured. Admin flag independence works end-to-end through the UI thanks to the new `admin-flag-<id>-row` Pressables (previous iterations had to flip flags via API because the RN-Web Switch ignored synthetic events). One minor divergence from the task text: the seeded spark b9c910be-… only has `itinerary-leg-0` because its 3rd stop has no lat/lng, so the backend returns a single travel leg — this is correct backend behaviour, documented, and not a bug.

A) ADMIN FLAG UI — logged in via Profile → Log In (auth-email/password/submit) → /admin → 3 rows + 3 switches present (admin-flag-experience-profiles[-row], -builder[-row], -output[-row]). Tap admin-flag-experience-output-row → input.checked flips False, others stay True → admin-save-button → GET /api/config/public returns {experience_profiles:true, experience_builder:true, experience_output:false} ⇒ OUTPUT INDEPENDENCE OK. Row tap again + Save → output back to true. Then tap admin-flag-experience-builder-row + Save → GET returns {profiles:true, builder:false, output:true} ⇒ BUILDER INDEPENDENCE OK. Restored all to true. (Toast selector was not asserted — toast dismisses quickly; successful persistence confirmed via API round-trip.)

B) OUTPUT ON — /spark/b9c910be-cb10-4af9-a48d-f2e3e5616b46 (owner guest-a91990e00dd0 set in localStorage as `datespark_guest_id`="guest-a91990e00dd0" — AsyncStorage web shim uses window.localStorage; keys are JSON-encoded by the custom storage util so a quoted value is required). Assertions all PASS: spark-detail-screen, spark-itinerary, itinerary-step-0..2, itinerary-step-0-duration='30 min', itinerary-step-1-duration='1 h 15 min', itinerary-leg-0 text='🚶 Walk ~2 min · <0.1 mi · Straight-line estimate — not a road, walking or transit route', cost-summary with cost-total='$84', cost-per-person='$14', body contains 'est. total · 6 people' and 'All 3 stops have an estimate.', travel-total='🚶~2 min · <0.1 mi walk between stops', estimate-disclaimer contains 'not confirmed venue prices', chip-party-size contains '6 people', chip-transport='🚶 Walk'. No itinerary-step-*-unpriced (all priced). itinerary-leg-1 ABSENT — confirmed via `GET /api/sparks/<id>`: backend returns `travel_legs` of length 1 because activity[2] has `lat=None, lng=None`; Timeline correctly skips rendering the second leg.

C) OUTPUT OFF — PUT /api/admin/config features={experience_output:false} → reload the same /spark/<id>: itinerary-step-0..2 STILL render with venue names and costs; itinerary-step-0-duration/itinerary-step-1-duration ABSENT; itinerary-leg-0/leg-1 ABSENT; cost-summary ABSENT; chip-party-size/chip-transport ABSENT. Then /create (output OFF but builder+profiles still ON) → surprise-me-toggle present ⇒ builder independence confirmed. Restored experience_output:true.

D) RESULTS SUMMARY CHIPS (output ON) — full builder flow: /create → scroll+PointerEvent click profile-friends → party-size-plus (party=5) → who-continue-button → vibe-option-foodie → vibe-continue-button → budget-quick-100 → budget-continue-button → distance-option-10 + location-input='Austin, TX' + Set → find-sparks-button (CTA label 'Continue' in builder mode) → create-when-screen → when-date-tomorrow → when-time-700pm → duration-2 → transport-walk → when-find-sparks-button → results-screen within 15s. Chips: results-summary-chips present, results-chip-budget contains '$100', results-chip-location='Austin · 10 miles', results-chip-when='Sat, Oct 10, 7:00 PM', results-chip-party contains '5 people', results-chip-duration contains '2 hours', results-chip-transport='Walk'. Did NOT wait for LLM completion — just the loading screen with correct chips (per task guidance).

E) RESULTS plain summary — verified as part of F (all-flags-OFF couple flow) because the in-memory draft prevents reusing D's results screen: results-summary-chips ABSENT, header shows plain line '$50–$100 • 10 miles • Austin'.

F) LEGACY COUPLE FLOW with ALL THREE flags OFF (PUT {experience_profiles:false, experience_builder:false, experience_output:false}): /create header '1/4', no experience-profile-row, no profile-friends/couple, no surprise-me-toggle, no party-size-card → who-option-partner → Continue → vibe header '2/4' and NO interests-disclose → vibe-option-romantic → Continue → budget header '3/4' and NO budget-amount-card → budget-option-50-100 → Continue → distance header '4/4' → distance-option-10 + 'Austin, TX' + Set → find-sparks-button CTA text exactly 'Find My Sparks ✨' → results-screen with results-loading, plain header '$50–$100 • 10 miles • Austin', NO results-summary-chips. Then PUT all three flags true and GET returns them true.

G) SURPRISE PRIVACY — generated a surprise spark via POST /api/sparks/generate with X-Guest-ID='guest-test-owner-i6a', X-Premium:1, partner/romantic/50-100/10mi/Austin/surprise:true/scheduled_at='2099-01-01T01:00:00Z'/transport:drive. Took ~40s, got 3 sparks each with 3 activities + 2 legs + total≈$67.5. Used id b8597fbb-8238-4b22-b442-31421656f441.
 • OWNER (localStorage datespark_guest_id='guest-test-owner-i6a'): spark-detail-screen, surprise-card, reveal-next-button text='Reveal stop 2 of 3 🎁', itinerary-step-0 unlocked, itinerary-step-1/2 both show '🔒 Stop N' + 'Revealed when you're ready — keep the mystery alive.', itinerary-leg-0 ABSENT (correct — legs only between revealed stops), cost-summary PRESENT (acceptable per task), chip-party-size ABSENT (party_size is null on this generated spark). Tap reveal-next-button → step-1 unlocks (text contains venue 'Doug Sahm Hill Summit', cost '~$0', 'until 2:15 AM'), step-2 still '🔒 Stop 3', itinerary-leg-0 NOW PRESENT.
 • RECIPIENT (different guest id 'guest-test-recipient-xyz'): invite-banner present, surprise-card contains 'It's a surprise 🎁' and 'The full plan unlocks at Thu, Jan 1, 1:00 AM.', spark-itinerary ABSENT, itinerary-step-0 ABSENT, itinerary-leg-0 ABSENT, cost-summary ABSENT, chip-party-size ABSENT, surprise-meet='Meet at 1:00 AM · Ann and Roy Butler Hike and Bike Trl, Austin, TX 78746, USA'.
 • GET /api/shared/<id> (no owner header): travel_legs=[], total_estimated_cost=None, activities count=0. Privacy fully preserved.

H) NO RED SCREENS — pageerror listener captured 0 errors across the entire session. Home/, /sparks, /profile all render correctly after login (admin profile shows '0 Saved · 1 Created · 0 Completed'). admin-forbidden never rendered for admin.

FINAL: GET /api/config/public = {experience_profiles:true, experience_builder:true, experience_output:true}.
critical_code_review_comments: features.ts correctly adds a third gate `output` keyed off `experience_output !== false` with the same `ready` discipline as profiles/builder, so no flash of itinerary legs / cost summary / chips before config settles. Independent of experience_profiles and experience_builder — verified by PUT with one flag flipped and checking the other two stay unchanged.

admin.tsx now wraps each flag in a Pressable `admin-flag-<id>-row` with a minHeight:44 — this resolves the long-standing RN-Web Switch synthetic-event blocker and lets Playwright flip flags through the UI (iteration 5 could only flip them via API). accessibilityRole='switch' + accessibilityState.checked are set correctly. Confirmed the Switch's inner <input> flips in sync.

Timeline.tsx: travel legs render ONLY when `enriched && !a.locked && !activities[i+1]?.locked && backend returned a leg with from_index=i,to_index=i+1`. This is the correct guard for both the output flag OFF path AND the surprise-privacy path (locked next stop ⇒ no leg). The seeded spark b9c910be only has leg-0 because stop 2 has no coords — correct backend behaviour, Timeline handles the gap gracefully.

CostSummary.tsx returns null when there's no cost AND no legs, correctly hiding the card for the output-OFF path and for recipients. Owner surprise view keeps the card (party_size null ⇒ no per-person figure, but total is shown) which matches the spec ('owner knows the plan').

costSummary() in plan.ts returns null when `priced===0` which means a spark with only unpriced stops shows no cost-summary card at all — the per-stop 'Price not listed' labels still appear via `itinerary-step-N-unpriced`. Good conservative default.

/api/shared/<id> correctly strips travel_legs → [] and total_estimated_cost → null for surprise sparks before the reveal time; the frontend therefore has no way to leak costs/legs to recipients even if a bug slipped in. Verified from the browser (no auth header, no X-Guest-ID matching owner).

visibleLegs() util (plan.ts:58) filters by `l.to_index < visibleStops` — exactly the right predicate for the owner's partial-reveal state. Confirmed: after tapping reveal (visibleStops goes 1→2), itinerary-leg-0 appears, step 1 becomes unlocked.
No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch references detected via grep in src/ and app/.
No files >700 lines in frontend/src that are relevant to this iteration (plan.ts 92, Timeline.tsx 108, CostSummary.tsx 79, admin.tsx 199, features.ts 25).

success_rate.backend: not retested per request (last known 99/99 via pytest)
success_rate.frontend: 8/8 scenarios PASS (A admin UI toggle, B output ON spark detail, C output OFF spark detail + builder-independence, D results summary chips, E plain summary when output OFF, F legacy couple flow all-flags-OFF, G surprise privacy owner+recipient+shared, H no red screens + tabs regression)

seed_data_creation: Generated 3 surprise sparks via POST /api/sparks/generate under X-Guest-ID='guest-test-owner-i6a' (used id b8597fbb-8238-4b22-b442-31421656f441 for the owner-vs-recipient privacy test). The pre-existing seeded spark b9c910be-cb10-4af9-a48d-f2e3e5616b46 (guest-a91990e00dd0, 6-person walk, 3 priced stops, $84 total) was used for the OUTPUT-ON and OUTPUT-OFF detail-screen checks. Feature flags were toggled off then restored to {true,true,true} via PUT /api/admin/config.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://vibe-finder-75.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin: admin@datespark.app / SparkAdmin2026!. Three feature flags: experience_profiles, experience_builder, experience_output — all editable via admin UI (click `admin-flag-<id>-row` Pressable, NOT the Switch — RN-Web Switch still ignores synthetic clicks). On web, AsyncStorage uses window.localStorage directly; the custom storage util JSON-stringifies values, so to impersonate a guest set `localStorage['datespark_guest_id']=JSON.stringify('<guest-id>')` BEFORE navigating to /spark/<id>. The create draft is in memory, so flag flips mid-flow don't re-enter the running wizard — re-start from /create after each flag flip. LLM takes 30–60s on /create/results; assert loading screen + header + chips rather than waiting for spark-card-0. The seeded spark b9c910be has only 1 leg because activity[2] has no lat/lng — expected. Viewport 390x844. Final state must be all three flags true: {experience_profiles:true, experience_builder:true, experience_output:true}.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Experience Output upgrade works to spec: itinerary enrichments (durations, straight-line travel legs with clear 'Straight-line estimate' hint, cost-summary with per-person + 'est. total · N people' + unpriced callout + disclaimer, chip row for party/transport, results-summary-chips) all gated behind experience_output flag and INDEPENDENT of experience_profiles / experience_builder. Admin label rows resolve the previous RN-Web Switch testability issue. Surprise privacy strictly enforced on both the detail screen (frontend) and /api/shared/<id> (backend).
